purpose: Record current System Master expectations under topology 004 while preserving Registry 002 as historical evidence of the superseded Prose-to-Documents allocation.

architecture_expectations.requirement: SYSTEM MASTER is the product root/system-of-systems.
CORE provides shared Foundation & Spine services and does not silently acquire peer-system semantic authority.
LEARNING is a first-class peer tool system inside SYSTEM MASTER.
BOOK is a first-class peer tool system owning canonical book/manuscript/lifecycle/Story-Bible/admission/author state.
DOCUMENTS is a first-class peer tool system owning document/artifact mechanics, formats, conversion, rendering, preservation/export and generic document services without Book canonical authority.
PROSE is an active specialist child at SYSTEM_MASTER/BOOK/PROSE. It owns Book-scoped literary intelligence but has zero canonical manuscript-write, admission, author or peer-lane authority.
Historical Prose retirement and exact-subject evidence remain preserved but cannot redirect active Book-Prose work to Documents or transfer PASS.

operating_expectations.requirement: Every executable work item has an explicit active owner path, exact current control binding, completion delta, evidence expectation, stop condition and next-state rule.
No newer branch/chat/workflow/ticket/archive becomes authority merely because it is newer.
Completed work and exact-subject evidence are append-only; current state selects from them without rewriting history.
Unallocated/candidate future-system work may be inspected and cataloged but may not execute, schedule, promote or redefine architecture until explicitly admitted.

Second Shift executes only registry-declared peer owner lanes and routes child specialist work through the parent owner lane; active Prose work inherits BOOK and never creates a separate Prose mutation lane.

Historical and archived assets must be traceable by exact source locator, identity/digest where available, lifecycle/evidence class, system/capability affinity, reuse disposition and provenance lineage before reuse.

A-01 may verify identity, process deterministic inventories, execute registered qualification and emit receipts/attestations, but it may not create systems, assign semantic ownership or transfer evidence authority across changed subjects.
A future system build begins from the reusable system/asset catalog and current-source delta review; completed research is not repeated without a material reopen trigger.

Foreground owner chats and Second Shift must ultimately arbitrate through one lane-wide mutation claim; until machine admission, concurrent mutation detection fails closed and reconciles the live head before writing.

historical_product_module_inventory.rule: The historical 40-module inventory is discovery/reuse evidence, not current topology. Lifecycle/ownership must be resolved through CURRENT-AUTHORITY and topology 004 before execution.

current_scope_clarifications.rule: Do not create duplicate Phone Operations authority.
Requires explicit future program authorization plus hardware/safety scope.
No full CAD system absent a concrete future owner decision.
No direct canonical manuscript write and no separate peer or Second Shift mutation lane.

change_rule: New product expectations require an explicit successor registry entry. Never erase or rewrite prior registries to conceal historical topology.
